events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU fragrance experience with personalized fragrance discovery and access to the broader COCO MADEMOISELLE line and CHANEL makeup.
events.what_is_free: Free public fragrance experience; appointments are limited and walk-ins are encouraged during event hours.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged. Walk-in admission remains subject to normal event capacity; do not describe an appointment as required.
events.practical_notes: Second weekend runs Sept. 18 noon–7 PM and Sept. 19–20 10 AM–7 PM at 873 Washington Street.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy’s Sampling
events.what_it_is: A one-day Herald Square Plaza activation celebrating Max Mara Le Parfum with fragrance sampling, complimentary gelato and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and a chance at giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: The current event listing does not state an RSVP requirement. Samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last. Patch is a contributed event listing rather than a first-party host page, so admission is based on the published listing and should be rechecked if stronger host evidence appears.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy’s Herald Square Plaza, 151 W 34th St.
